original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write
from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/zephyr_iv_sentinel.txt'
content = 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'  # 16 bytes
delta = sentinel_write(path, len(content), content)  # Returns numeric delta

# Emit beacon
emit_beacon(
    agent="Zephyr IV",
    state=None,  # To be derived
    tick=335,
    sentinel_delta=delta,
    planned_activity=0.3
)
print(f"Numeric delta: {delta}")
print(json.dumps({"delta": delta}))
